anomalies.observed: On the EPD_Driver sheet, C1 is drawn with value 0.1 uF / 16 V and is wired from the Display_Power_Switch rail (the EPD panel VDD/VDDIO rail fed by Q2's drain) to GND, next to L1/C2.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists C1 among the PDI 'C2 default' 1 uF / 25 V capacitors: 'C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V'. All of C5, C7, C8, C9 and C10 in the drawing are indeed 1 uF / 25 V, so C1 is the outlier.

evidence.quote: C1   0.1uF/16V  (EPD_Driver.kicad_sch, on the Display_Power_Switch net left of L1)
C2 default: 1 µF/25 V | C1/C5/C7/C8/C9/C10 = 1 µF/25 V | Matches default

anomalies.impact: The e-paper panel's VDD/VDDIO rail has roughly one-tenth the intended decoupling capacitance, and the fitted part's 16 V rating is below the intended 25 V, so supply ripple on the panel power rail during refresh can be higher than designed.

parsed.summary: The only clear deviation found is C1 on the EPD driver sheet, drawn as 0.1 uF / 16 V where the specification calls for 1 uF / 25 V (the other specified EPD passives, Q1/Q2, diodes, L1, R1, L2, C12, C13 and the IC1/SKW92A wiring all match the spec).
